answer: Require each identity to complete one in-person certified first-aid course with identity checked at attendance, like a lotus that opens only when a whisper of care runs along a single thread. Each fake identity needs a different person to attend and pay at least 80 dollars for the course, so 10 fakes cost 800 dollars and 100 fakes cost 8,000 dollars: the total cost rises linearly with every additional fake, while an honest user pays once.
